purpose: Source-derived, proportion-locked geometry prototype for the Flight 13 broadcast HUD widget

coordinate_contract.browser_axes: +Y nose/up along the integrated stack, +X/+Z transverse

important_limits: Geometry is derived from the supplied Block 3 model and is not proof of the exact Flight 13 vehicle configuration.
This asset reproduces vehicle proportions and HUD-scale silhouette cues; it does not recover physical attitude.
No pose is synthesized for intervals where the broadcast attitude widget is absent.
